ns2:section.sectionText: Meets with HIST 495, Section D. Topic: Disabilities and the University of Illinois Description: In 1949, the University reluctantly admitted "wheelchair students." Today the University of Illinois welcomes students with disabilities and celebrates its Paralympic athelets. This course investigates that transformation. Students will research and write the history of disabilities at the university. Topics include the social construction of disabilities, student life, education, sports, housing, veterans, gender, race, and sexuality. The course is part of the Ethnography of the University Initiative (EUI).
